edges.guard: Top10 membership is frozen; the anchor candidate set is never regenerated or re-selected.
Only exact Len3 users are touched; rerank stays strictly inside the original V23 Top7; alpha fixed at 0.50.
Only Novel slots are reranked; alpha fixed at 0.50; history items are never demoted or removed.
At most one external item may be admitted, only at position 10; all other positions are protected.

nodes.role: Fixed, teammate-verified V23 Top10 candidate set; the immutable starting point.
v42c-DIN bucket specialist reranks exact Len3 users strictly inside the original V23 Top7 (alpha=0.50).
C_all specialist reranks Novel slots only (alpha=0.50); everything else is a protected residual.
Boundary admission: at most one external item enters, only at position 10.

protected_residual: History items, non-Len3 users, and Top10 membership are protected at every stage.
source_consensus_gate: Any new source must pass a consensus gate against the frozen anchor before it can influence the ranking.
